Escolha os motores Estável, Dinâmico ou: Choose the Stable, Dynamic, or Mixed solver in Settings. Simulation covers DC, transient, and limited mixed logic with generic models; see below for remaining gaps.
O ProtoCraft já oferece esquemas, netlis: ProtoCraft already offers schematics, netlists, basic ERC, DC/transient/mixed simulation, and an initial PCB flow with routing and export. It does not yet match the full Proteus feature set.
Maior lacuna: firmware de microcontrolad: Biggest gap: microcontroller firmware. STM32/ESP32 devices can be placed as physical components, but they do not run firmware or simulate peripherals; debugging and co-simulation are also missing.
Simulação avançada: faltam AC de pequeno: Advanced simulation: small-signal AC and frequency, sweep, noise, and Fourier analyses are missing. The current scope is DC, transient, and limited mixed logic.
PCB profissional: faltam zonas de cobre,: Professional PCB design: copper zones, net-class rules, differential pairs, length/impedance control, multilayer boards, and broader manufacturing checks are missing.
Bibliotecas e produtividade: o catálogo: Libraries and productivity: the catalog and models are more limited; a bill of materials, complete assembly outputs, and advanced project analysis/navigation tools are missing.
Importação: só há um perfil restrito do: Import: only a restricted single-sheet Proteus profile is supported. Hierarchy, buses, scripts, models, firmware, instruments, probes, and generators may not be preserved.
Prioridade: construção e validação de PC: Priority: PCB construction and validation, then simulation and instruments. Firmware and 3D are future work.
Contínua mantém o estado elétrico entre: Continuous simulation preserves electrical state between steps. Double-click a switch or logic input to toggle it. A topology change resets time; parameter changes preserve state.
Mover/rotacionar componente não acompanh: Moving or rotating a component does not move its wires; check pins and run ERC after each edit. Experimental Proteus import is under File; save the result as .protocraft.
Projeto físico: confira a pinagem e a PC: Physical design: review the pinout and PCB.

ProtoCraft — circuit automation

Usage:
  protocraft-cli templates
  protocraft-cli new --output project.protocraft [--template 555-led-1hz|raspberry-pi-4-shield|raspberry-pi-hat] [--name 'My circuit'] [--open]
  protocraft-cli open <project.protocraft>
  protocraft-cli devices [--filter term] [--limit N] [--offset N]
  protocraft-cli device <model>
  protocraft-cli device-project <model> --output project.protocraft
  protocraft-cli raspberry-pi-4-shield --output project.protocraft
  protocraft-cli raspberry-pi-hat --output project.protocraft
  protocraft-cli pcb-check <project>
  protocraft-cli pcb-route <project> --output routed.protocraft [--grid-mm 0.25] [--track-width-mm 0.25] [--max-expansions 600000] [--no-optimize]
  protocraft-cli pcb-info <project>
  protocraft-cli pcb-export <project> --format kicad|svg --output file
  protocraft-cli pcb-manufacture <project> --preset jlcpcb|standard --output new-folder --kicad path/kicad-cli.exe
  protocraft-cli engines
  protocraft-cli components
  protocraft-cli examples <folder>
  protocraft-cli import-proteus <file.pdsprj|file.dsn> --output <file.protocraft> [--report <report.json>]
  protocraft-cli info <file.protocraft>
  protocraft-cli commands [--filter <term>]
  protocraft-cli run <file.protocraft> (--actions <actions.json> | --cmd <id> --params '<json>' [...]) [--output <new.protocraft>]
  protocraft-cli validate <file.protocraft>
  protocraft-cli netlist <file.protocraft>
  protocraft-cli simulate <file.protocraft> [--engine stable|dynamic|mixed] [--transient step_s end_s] [--csv file.csv]
  protocraft-cli spice <file.protocraft> [--transient step_s end_s] [--output file.cir]

new creates a project; --open starts the desktop editor if it is installed beside the CLI.
run applies all commands as one atomic Engine edit; use --output to save the result.
info, commands, and run write JSON to stdout. Points use integer grid coordinates.
Proteus import is experimental: review the warnings and limitations report.
Native simulation is written in Rust: stable, dynamic, and mixed solvers; DC and transient analyses; generic models.
Use engines and components to inspect available options. C/L start at zero; digital states can be configured with the Mixed solver.

Usage: protocraft-cli convert <input> --output <destination> --to <protocraft|kicad-pcb|kicad-sch> [--from auto|protocraft|proteus|kicad-pcb|kicad-sch] [--report <json>] [--allow-lossy]
Conversions with losses are refused by default. Review the report before allowing --allow-lossy. Existing files are not replaced.
S-expression inválida ou acima dos limit: Invalid S-expression or file exceeds safety limits.
Esquemático KiCad inválido ou fora do su: Invalid KiCad schematic or file is outside the supported subset.
Gráficos de símbolos e anotações não for: Symbol graphics and annotations were not preserved.
Objetos de esquema sem suporte foram omi: Unsupported schematic objects were omitted; review connectivity.
Símbolo sem definição incorporada ou com: Symbol has no embedded definition or unresolved inheritance.
Unidades ou pinos de símbolo não puderam: Symbol units or pins could not be mapped completely.
A geometria PCB não representa o esquema: PCB geometry does not represent the original schematic and was not exported.
Metadados e modelos de simulação não são: Metadata and simulation models are not converted by this interchange.
Conectividade importada sem modelos de s: Connectivity was imported without simulation models; symbols are represented by pins and metadata.
Texto contém caracteres de controle sem: Text contains control characters without a safe S-expression representation.
Catálogos CDB ambíguos: existem arquivos: Ambiguous CDB catalogs: distinct .CDB and .cdb files both exist.
DSN independente: a assinatura ISIS foi: Standalone DSN: the ISIS signature was recognized, but the original version could not be confirmed by PROJECT.XML; this does not establish support for all legacy versions.
PCB do contêiner não importada: posicion: Container PCB was not imported: placements, copper, vias, holes, zones, and manufacturing rules remain only in the original file.
A conversão não preserva integralmente o: The conversion does not fully preserve Proteus format and cannot faithfully re-export to DSN/PDSPrj. electrical_complete describes electrical equivalence only, not format fidelity.
DSN Specctra de PCB não é um esquema Pro: Specctra PCB DSN is not a Proteus ISIS schematic.
Seções de circuito adicionais não import: Additional circuit sections not imported: {omitted}. Only the first section was converted.
Símbolo de alimentação não pôde ser conv: Power symbol could not be converted into an unambiguous global net.
Tipos elétricos de pinos e modelos de si: Pin electrical types and simulation models were not imported; only pins and fields are available.
A referência de footprint foi preservada: The footprint reference was preserved as a property but was not linked to the physical catalog.
Referência KiCad {reference} foi normali: KiCad reference {reference} was normalized to {safe_reference}; the original name was retained in metadata.
Importação restrita à placa KiCad (versã: Import is limited to the KiCad board (version {version}); the original schematic and electrical models are not present in the PCB file.
{reference} possui mais de 64 números de: {reference} has more than 64 pin numbers; the component was omitted.
{reference} não possui pads elétricos nu: {reference} has no numbered electrical pads and was omitted from the component model.
{reference} pad {number} referencia à re: {reference} pad {number} refers to KiCad net {net_id}, which is missing from the net table.
Trilha na camada {layer} foi omitida; o: Track on layer {layer} was omitted; the model supports F.Cu and B.Cu.
Trilha da rede {net_id} sem pad de refer: Track on net {net_id} without a reference pad was omitted.
Via da rede {net_id} sem pad de referênc: Via on net {net_id} without a reference pad was omitted.
Rotação não ortogonal de {footprint} foi: Non-orthogonal rotation of {footprint} was baked into the geometry with nanometer rounding.
Posição, camada ou estilo de texto das p: Text position, layer, or style of {reference} properties is not preserved.
Tecnologia de pad {technology} convertid: Pad technology {technology} was converted to SMD.
Pad customizado {number} foi aproximado: Custom pad {number} was approximated by its bounding rectangle.
Forma de pad {shape} convertida para ret: Pad shape {shape} was converted to a rectangle.
Pads com número {number} em {reference}: Pads numbered {number} on {reference} belong to different nets; only the first assignment was kept.
Footprint {footprint} sem pads foi omiti: Footprint {footprint} has no pads and was omitted.
Texto de referência/valor de {reference}: Reference/value text for {reference} had its style and position omitted.
A propriedade {property} de um pad de {r: Pad property {property} on {reference} is not preserved.
{reference}: limite mecânico foi aproxim: {reference}: the mechanical boundary was approximated from pad and line bounds because no recognizable courtyard was found.
Objetos de placa {kind} não são preserva: Board objects of type {kind} are not preserved by the current model.
Recurso KiCad desconhecido {kind} não fo: Unknown KiCad feature {kind} was not imported.

O contorno Edge.Cuts não é um retângulo: The Edge.Cuts outline is not a representable rectangle; the PCB uses only its bounding box.

As classes e regras de rede do KiCad não: KiCad net classes and rules are not converted to native PCB classes.
A pilha de cobre contém camadas internas: The copper stackup contains inner layers that are absent from the ProtoCraft board model.
Somente espessura e folga global de cobr: Only thickness and global copper clearance are read; other setup manufacturing and DRC rules are not imported.
Alguns nomes de rede foram omitidos para: Some net names were omitted to stay within the project object limit.

Via sem identificador de rede foi omitid: Via without a net identifier was omitted.
Zonas de cobre, ilhas, preenchimento tér: Copper zones, islands, thermal fills, and keepout areas cannot be represented and were omitted.
Arcos, polígonos ou círculos gráficos do: Board model cannot represent arcs, polygons, or graphic circles from the file.
O esquemático sintético contém somente p: The synthetic schematic contains only imported pins and PCB net names; it does not replace the KiCad schematic or enable electrical simulation.
Via cega, enterrada ou com camadas não s: Blind, buried, or unsupported-layer via was omitted.
Múltiplos retângulos Edge.Cuts foram red: Multiple Edge.Cuts rectangles were reduced to a bounding box.

O arquivo excede o limite de 100.000 pad: File exceeds the 100,000 supported pad limit.

DFM_DRILL_CLEARANCE: Drills violate the minimum manufacturing drill clearance.
assembly_variant.invalid_config: Invalid assembly variant: empty or oversized name, or too many references.
assembly_variant.invalid_reference: Unknown or nonphysical component reference in assembly variant.
sweep.invalid: Invalid sweep configuration: use 2 to 128 finite points and a resistor or DC source; log scale requires positive values.
sweep.help: Usage: protocraft-cli dc-sweep <project> --component <reference> --start <SI> --stop <SI> --points N [--scale linear|log] [--engine stable|dynamic|mixed] [--output new.json]
measurement.invalid_trace: Invalid trace: requires 2 to 2,000,000 finite samples with strictly increasing timestamps and finite results.
measurement.invalid_window: Invalid measurement window: use finite bounds within the trace, start before end, and a finite threshold.
measurement.incompatible_reference: The differential reference must have the same unit and timestamps as the trace.
measurement.cli_help:
Usage: protocraft-cli simulate-measure <project> --trace <name> --step <seconds> --stop <seconds> [--reference <name>] [--from <seconds>] [--to <seconds>] [--threshold <value>] [--engine stable|dynamic|mixed] [--output new.json]
Measures linear sample interpolation; mean and RMS use time weighting. Frequency requires two rising threshold crossings.
advanced_workflows.help: Design and analysis: pcb-assembly-variant generates variant BOM/positions; dc-sweep sweeps resistor or DC source values; simulate-measure measures traces and differential signals. Use <command> --help.
DRC_DRILL_DIAGNOSTIC_LIMIT: Drilling DRC exceeded its diagnostic limit; verification was stopped.
assembly_variant.invalid_json: Invalid assembly variant configuration: malformed JSON or unknown fields.
